resumen: Standing, the bar goes from the shoulders to overhead. The whole trunk works to avoid arching while the shoulders press.
ejecucion: Stand with the bar resting on the upper chest, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squeeze glutes and abs: that is what keeps the back from arching as you press.
Press the bar up, moving your head slightly back to let it pass.
Finish with the bar over your head and arms straight, then lower under control.
matices: The variant shifts the balance: behind the neck brings out more rear and side delt, in front brings in more chest. With a barbell the body also stabilises more than on a machine.
